messages:
alex: Ran into weird provisional billing in staging: prefetch sidecar seems to be creating a provisional token charge even when the main stream immediately 204s. Screenshot in console shows +1 token for the request despite no model response.
priya: ugh. is this the prefetch path we added for low-latency embeddings?
alex: yeah, sidecar fires a prefetch toolcall to the embedding model, gets a keepalive, then client gets a stream EOF. Our ledger shows a provisional credit for the sidecar call that never reconciled.
jamie: can you paste the logs (request ids)? might be the provisional->confirmed path not getting the confirm event on stream truncation.
alex: request id r-0a1b2c3d 
alex: log snip: ```
[sidecar] prefetch sent toolcall id=tc-179 
[router] routed -> model-a (prefetch)
[model] 204 no-content
[sidecar] provisional_charge token=1 id=tc-179
[router] client EOF -> close session
[ledger] provisional recorded tc-179
```
priya: interesting—model returned 204, but sidecar still recorded provisional. We only confirm on streaming token ack. If there's no ack path, ledger stays provisional.
li: is this specific to staging routing? we recently toggled the canary routing policy that preferred sidecar for low-priority requests. Maybe fallback path didn't emit confirm.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary-routing v2 deployed to staging at 2026-03-18T16:02Z :white_check_mark:
jamie: right. canary routing switches route mid-request if capacity changes. If the router handoff happens after provisional, confirm may be emitted to previous proxy and never reach ledger.
priya: we should add a guaranteed confirm-on-abort flow: whenever a stream is truncated or 204 returned, sidecars should emit a provisional-cancel event. Ledger then reconciles to zero.
alex: agree. quick mitigation: console should show provisional-only charges flagged as "staging/canary" with a tooltip. Ops can filter them out in billing queries.
li: small UX ask: add a toggle in the console to hide provisional credits older than X minutes (we do this for provisional spikes) — saves ops noise.
jamie: implement plan: 1) sidecar emits provisional-cancel on stream close 2) router ensures handoff forwards confirm/cancel events 3) console adds provisional filter + badge. I'll open a PR for (1) and (2).
priya: also add a monitoring alert for provisional:confirmed ratio > 0.1 in staging over 5m.
alex: thanks. I'll update the internal runbook and attach a sample query for the console.
li: tagging for product: @priya @jamie can we include a note in the rollouts UX doc about canary routing and provisional billing quirks?
priya: yes, will add a section.
alex: TL;DR: sidecar prefetch + canary handoff -> provisional stuck when stream truncates. Fix = cancel path and console filters. :thumbsup:
